I also wasted turns trying to move the pillow before realizing my inventory was full, and I failed to check the pantry for the mop. The corrected strategy is: first, go to the kitchen and open the refrigerator to retrieve the apple. Second, immediately go to the pantry, open it, and take the mop. Third, go to the kitchen, open the refrigerator, and put the apple inside. Fourth, go to the kitchen, open the cupboard, and take the plate. Finally, go to the living room and place the plate on the side table. Only after all three items are in their correct locations should I issue the "done" command.

Third, go to the kitchen, open the cupboard, and take the mop. Fourth, go to the living room and place the mop on the shelf. Finally, go to the kitchen, open the refrigerator, and take the apple.
